profiles.bio: Space Ibiza was one of the most legendary clubs in dance-music history, known for its marathon parties and open-air terrace where airplanes roared overhead as DJs played sunrise sets. It became a global symbol of Ibiza’s club culture, blending house, techno, and Balearic sounds in an atmosphere that shaped the evolution of modern nightlife and inspired generations of DJs and clubgoers. Even after its closure in 2016, its influence continues to define how the world imagines the spirit and energy of Ibiza.

Founded in Ibiza in 1989 by brothers Sito and Antonio Lara, DC10 evolved from a small music bar beside the airport runway into one of the island's defining underground clubs. Circoloco joined the venue in 1999 and became synonymous with DC10's Monday sessions, built around house and techno and a music-first club culture.
